national_news.title: NSA Ajit Doval Addresses 8th NSA-Level Meeting of Colombo Security Conclave in Male
bullets: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval addressed the 8th National Security Advisors’ Meeting of the Colombo Security Conclave in Male, Maldives.
The Colombo Security Conclave was formed in November 2020 to ensure safety, security, and stability in the Indian Ocean Region.
Mr Doval linked the grouping to India's 'Neighbourhood First' policy and the broader MAHASAGAR vision.

national_news.title: SEBI Proposes Early Pay-Out Framework for FPOs in Agricultural Commodity Derivatives
bullets: SEBI proposed a framework allowing Early Pay-Out of up to 80% of sale value to Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs) in agricultural commodity derivatives.
The move aims to ease working capital constraints for FPOs after depositing agricultural produce in accredited warehouses.
Eligible corporate trading members must have a minimum net worth of three crore rupees with exposure capped at three times their net worth.

national_news.title: Air Passenger Service Inflation Surges to 35.52% in Q2 of Current Fiscal Year
bullets: Air passenger service inflation surged to 35.52% annually in Q2, highest among seven service sectors according to provisional SPPI data.
Ministry of Commerce and Industry released the Provisional Service Producer Price Indices (SPPIs) data.
Banking service inflation rose to 3.86%, while securities transaction service prices recorded a deflation of 6.93%.

national_news.title: President Murmu Addresses Bali Jatra Festival, Emphasises India-Indonesia Historical Ties
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu addressed the Bali Jatra Festival at Cuttack in Odisha, highlighting the ancient maritime heritage of Odisha's sea traders.
The festival celebrated historical commercial and cultural connections between Odisha and Bali, featuring participating cultural troupes from Indonesia.
The address underscored how historical maritime routes continue to strengthen modern India-Indonesia bilateral cooperation and support the vision of Viksit Bharat.

national_news.title: Indian Army's Team Mountain Eagles Executes Historic Landing on NH-754K in Gujarat
bullets: The Indian Army's aero-adventure formation 'Team Mountain Eagles' successfully landed and refuelled microlight aircraft and powered hang gliders on NH-754K near Patan district, Gujarat.

The exercise was conducted along the Amritsar-Jamnagar Expressway near Bakutra Toll Plaza as part of the 'Wings of Valour and Unity' Expedition led by the Military College of Telecommunication Engineering (MCTE), Mhow.
Executed in coordination with the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) and civil administration, the event demonstrated the dual-use potential of national highways as emergency landing strips.

national_news.title: India and Nepal Announce Major Connectivity, Energy, and Development Projects
bullets: India and Nepal adopted a Joint Vision Document to lay down a future-oriented roadmap for bilateral partnership during Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah's State Visit to India.

Key connectivity projects announced include the launch of the Sarayu-Kamala Express rail service connecting Ayodhya in India with Janakpur in Nepal, along with expanding access to Indian ports for Nepal's transit cargo.

India announced a development assistance package worth ₹15,000 crore (24,000 crore Nepali rupees) and signed eight MoUs covering healthcare, traditional medicine, and satellite communication networks.

national_news.title: Nation Celebrates 557th Parkash Purab of Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji
bullets: The 557th Parkash Purab of Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji, the founder of Sikhism who advocated 'Ek Onkar' (One God) and social equality, was celebrated across India and globally.
Guru Nanak Dev Ji was born in 1469 on the full moon day of Katak month at Rai Bhoi Ki Talwandi (now Nankana Sahib, Pakistan) to Mehta Kalu Ji and Mata Tripta Ji.
Key centers of pilgrimage during the occasion included Gurdwara Ber Sahib at Sultanpur Lodhi, Punjab—where Guru Nanak meditated for nearly 15 years—and Sri Harmandir Sahib in Amritsar.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Floats Tender For Solarisation Of Agricultural Feeders Across State
bullets: Bihar State Power Generation Company Limited (BSPGCL) invited bids to solarize segregated and mixed agricultural feeders under the RESCO mode.
Power generated will be procured by NBPDCL and SBPDCL, with bidding deadline set for December 31, 2026.
The Agri-Photovoltaic (AgriPV) system requires maintaining agricultural yields at no less than 80% of baseline yield while ensuring continuous electricity generation.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Plans Ropeways at 20 Major Tourist Destinations
bullets: The Bihar Government announced plans to develop ropeway facilities at 20 major tourist destinations to promote religious, historical, and eco-tourism.
Key projects include a 7-km Patna-Sonepur ropeway connecting JP Ganga Path to Hariharnath Temple across the Ganga.
Projects like Brahmayoni, Dungeshwari, and Pretshila hills in Gaya have received substantial financial allocations and central land approvals.

bihar_news.title: 799 Plastic Waste Management Units Found Only on Paper Across 29 Bihar Districts
bullets: A major discrepancy surfaced in Bihar where 29 districts claimed on paper to have established 931 plastic waste management units under the Lohiya Swachh Bihar Abhiyan.
Following a central mandate for geo-tagging and photographic proof on the IMIS portal of the Swachh Bharat Mission, valid records were submitted for only 132 units, leaving 799 units unverified.
The Chief Executive Officer cum Mission Director of Lohiya Swachh Bihar Abhiyan issued notices to district officials demanding explanations within three days under threat of departmental action.

bihar_news.title: National Milk Day 2026 Celebrated in Patna with Major Dairy Initiatives and Infrastructure Projects
bullets: National Milk Day 2026 was celebrated at Bapu Sabhagar in Patna, Bihar, organized by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD) under the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying.

Union Minister Rajiv Ranjan Singh (Lalan Singh) presented the National Gopal Ratna Awards 2026 to recognize outstanding contributions to indigenous cattle/buffalo breed conservation and dairy development.

Several infrastructure projects were inaugurated, including mineral mixture plants in Patna and Muzaffarpur, an effluent treatment plant at Mithila Milk Union in Samastipur, and Namaste India's 2 lakh litres per day milk processing plant in Bihta, Patna.
